name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states.
usageSnippet: Accept terms and conditions

props.name: checked
props.description: The controlled checked state of the checkbox

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description:
The initial checked state of the checkbox when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the checked state of the checkbox.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form that the checkbox belongs to.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the checkbox. Useful for composition.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the input field in a checkbox.
Useful for form submission.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of checkbox input. Useful for form submission.

events.name: onCheckedChange
events.description: The callback invoked when the checked state changes.

keyboard.description: Toggles the checkbox between checked and unchecked.
Moves focus to the next focusable element; skips the checkbox entirely when `disabled`.

accessibilityNotes: Renders a native hidden `<input type="checkbox">` under a styled root `<label>`, so it participates in native form submission and inherits the platform's checkbox semantics.

Always pair the checkbox with visible label text: either as the checkbox's own `content` body (its root element is already a `<label>`), or an external `FieldLabel`/`Label` with `for` matching the checkbox's `id` — never wrap a `Checkbox` in a second `<label>`, since that nests two label elements around the same control.
Set `aria-invalid="true"` on the checkbox (and `invalid` on a wrapping `Field`) when validation fails — screen readers announce the invalid state.
Set `disabled` to remove the control from the tab order and block pointer input.

The indeterminate state (`checked="indeterminate"`) is a purely visual/ARIA cue for partial selection (e.g. "select all" with a mixed subset checked); it is not a persisted value — the underlying control is still binary "checked" or "unchecked" once toggled.

examples.title: Basic
examples.source:
import Checkbox from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/checkbox/checkbox.marko";
import Field from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field.marko";
import FieldContent from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-content.marko";
import FieldDescription from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-description.marko";
import FieldGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-group.marko";
import FieldLabel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-label.marko";

<FieldGroup class="max-w-sm">
  <Field orientation="horizontal">
    <Checkbox id="checkbox-demo-terms">Accept terms and conditions</Checkbox>
  </Field>
  <Field orientation="horizontal">
    <Checkbox id="checkbox-demo-terms-2" ids={ hiddenInput: "checkbox-demo-terms-2" } defaultChecked/>
    <FieldContent>
      <FieldLabel for="checkbox-demo-terms-2">Accept terms and conditions</FieldLabel>
      <FieldDescription>By clicking this checkbox, you agree to the terms.</FieldDescription>
    </FieldContent>
  </Field>
  <Field orientation="horizontal" disabled>
    <Checkbox id="checkbox-demo-toggle" disabled>Enable notifications</Checkbox>
  </Field>
  <Field orientation="horizontal">
    <Checkbox id="checkbox-demo-toggle-2" ids={ hiddenInput: "checkbox-demo-toggle-2" }/>
    <FieldContent>
      <FieldLabel for="checkbox-demo-toggle-2" class="mu-field-title">Enable notifications</FieldLabel>
      <FieldDescription>You can enable or disable notifications at any time.</FieldDescription>
    </FieldContent>
  </Field>
</FieldGroup>
examples.description: Four common `Checkbox` + `Field` pairings: plain content, `FieldLabel` + `FieldDescription`, a disabled field, and `FieldTitle` + `FieldDescription`.

examples.title: Invalid
examples.source:
import Checkbox from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/checkbox/checkbox.marko";
import Field from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field.marko";

<Field class="mx-auto w-56" orientation="horizontal" invalid>
  <Checkbox id="checkbox-invalid-terms" aria-invalid="true" class="font-normal">
    Accept terms and conditions
  </Checkbox>
</Field>
examples.description: Set `aria-invalid="true"` on the checkbox and `invalid` on the wrapping `Field` to show the invalid styles. Note the label is the checkbox's own `content` body, not a `FieldLabel` wrapper: `Checkbox` already renders a root `<label>` around its hidden input, so nesting a second `<label>` would be invalid HTML (upstream pairs a bare checkbox with an external label instead).

examples.title: Group
examples.source:
import Checkbox from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/checkbox/checkbox.marko";
import Field from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field.marko";
import FieldDescription from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-description.marko";
import FieldGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-group.marko";
import FieldLegend from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-legend.marko";
import FieldSet from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-set.marko";

<FieldSet>
  <FieldLegend variant="label">Show these items on the desktop:</FieldLegend>
  <FieldDescription>Select the items you want to show on the desktop.</FieldDescription>
  <FieldGroup class="gap-3">
    <Field orientation="horizontal">
      <Checkbox id="checkbox-group-hard-disks" defaultChecked class="font-normal">Hard disks</Checkbox>
    </Field>
    <Field orientation="horizontal">
      <Checkbox id="checkbox-group-external-disks" defaultChecked class="font-normal">External disks</Checkbox>
    </Field>
    <Field orientation="horizontal">
      <Checkbox id="checkbox-group-cds-dvds" class="font-normal">CDs, DVDs, and iPods</Checkbox>
    </Field>
    <Field orientation="horizontal">
      <Checkbox id="checkbox-group-connected-servers" class="font-normal">Connected servers</Checkbox>
    </Field>
  </FieldGroup>
</FieldSet>
examples.description: Use multiple `Field`s inside a `FieldSet` to create a checkbox list.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source:
import Checkbox from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/checkbox/checkbox.marko";
import Field from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field.marko";
import FieldContent from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-content.marko";
import FieldDescription from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-description.marko";
import FieldGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-group.marko";
import FieldLabel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-label.marko";

<FieldGroup class="max-w-sm" dir="rtl">
  <Field orientation="horizontal">
    <Checkbox id="checkbox-rtl-terms">قبول الشروط والأحكام</Checkbox>
  </Field>
  <Field orientation="horizontal">
    <Checkbox id="checkbox-rtl-terms-2" ids={ hiddenInput: "checkbox-rtl-terms-2" } defaultChecked/>
    <FieldContent>
      <FieldLabel for="checkbox-rtl-terms-2">قبول الشروط والأحكام</FieldLabel>
      <FieldDescription>بالنقر على هذا المربع، فإنك توافق على الشروط.</FieldDescription>
    </FieldContent>
  </Field>
  <Field orientation="horizontal" disabled>
    <Checkbox id="checkbox-rtl-toggle" disabled>تفعيل الإشعارات</Checkbox>
  </Field>
  <Field orientation="horizontal">
    <Checkbox id="checkbox-rtl-toggle-2" ids={ hiddenInput: "checkbox-rtl-toggle-2" }/>
    <FieldContent>
      <FieldLabel for="checkbox-rtl-toggle-2" class="mu-field-title">تفعيل الإشعارات</FieldLabel>
      <FieldDescription>يمكنك تفعيل أو إلغاء تفعيل الإشعارات في أي وقت.</FieldDescription>
    </FieldContent>
  </Field>
</FieldGroup>
examples.description: Checkboxes restyle correctly under `dir="rtl"` — logical Tailwind properties, not physical ones, drive layout and text alignment.
